wx: The George and Martha Hitchcock House, also known as the Fuller-McGuire House, is a private house located at 205 East Michigan Street in Farwell, Michigan, United States. It was designated a Michigan State Historic Site in 1996 and listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1985.
